d: The Accountant is responsible for accurately recording daily financial transactions and managing receipts, payments, expenses, and payroll. The role includes executing bank transfers, preparing monthly and closing entries, maintaining secure and organized financial records, and ensuring the accuracy and integrity of accounting entries. The Accountant is also responsible for reconciling customer, bank, and supplier balances and resolving any discrepancies.
Accurately record all daily financial transactions.
Process and record receipts and payments on a daily basis.
Record daily expenses and prepare payroll statements.
Execute bank transfers and monitor banking operations.
Prepare monthly accounting entries and closing entries.
Maintain secure, organized, and accessible financial records.
Ensure the accuracy and integrity of all accounting entries.
Conduct periodic reconciliations of customer, bank, and supplier balances to identify and resolve discrepancies.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or an equivalent qualification.

d: Barzan University College (BUC), in academic partnership with Swinburne University of Technology, invites applications for academic positions in its Computer Science Department. These are excellent opportunities for experienced academics and industry professionals to deliver Swinburne programs on campus in Doha.
We are recruiting for the following positions
Lecturer/Senior Lecturer – Computer Science (Cybersecurity): full-time, Bachelor and Master's programs
Part-Time Lecturers – Computer Science: Foundation and Bachelor programs
Computer Science Department | Full-time | Bachelor and Master's Programs

The successful candidate will contribute to high-quality teaching, research, and curriculum development in cybersecurity and related computing disciplines, ensuring alignment with international academic standards and transnational education (TNE) quality frameworks. The role carries a teaching load of 3–4 units in each of Terms 1 and 2 and 1–2 units in Summer, across the Bachelor of Computer Science and the Master of Cyber Security.
q: Candidates should demonstrate strength in several of the following areas. This list is indicative and not exhaustive:
x86/x64 assembly language programming and CPU architecture fundamentals
Binary exploitation: buffer overflows, stack smashing, and Return Oriented Programming
Debuggers and memory forensics tools including the Volatility framework
Network security: firewalls, IDS/IPS, packet analysis, and penetration testing
Web application vulnerabilities: XSS, SQL injection, phishing, and authentication flaws
Cryptography: encryption, hashing, digital signatures, and PKI
Malware analysis, OS hardening, identity and access management (including Active Directory), and vulnerability management
Digital forensics, incident response, and security log analysis
Security frameworks and governance: NIST, MITRE ATT&CK, ISO 27001, and ICT ethics
Cloud, IoT/OT and industrial control system security

PhD in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Security, or a closely related field, from a recognised university, eligible for MoEHE equivalency and Swinburne teaching approval (degrees earned by distance or online study must meet MoEHE recognition rules).

At least 5 years of industry experience in security roles such as penetration testing, security operations (SOC), incident response, security engineering or architecture, or security consulting; OR a track record of founding or building a security venture.
One or more current, verifiable industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, OSCP, CISSP, CISM, GIAC, CEH, or a cloud security specialty (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).
Cisco Certified Academy Instructor status (or willingness to obtain it).
At least 2 years of university-level teaching, or equivalent experience as a certified professional instructor (e.g., EC-Council, Cisco or SANS).
Experience in transnational education environments is an advantage.
Highly fluent English, outstanding communication skills and the ability to explain hard ideas plainly to students and employers.
Experience in AI security, adversarial machine learning or data privacy, and the ability to teach AI or machine learning units
Applied research or innovation with demonstrable impact: industry-funded projects, deployed systems, products or granted patents
Experience coaching CTF teams, running bug-bounty programs or leading red- or blue-team exercises
Strong curriculum development and assessment design skills
Ability to integrate theory with practical laboratory-based learning
Familiarity with Qatar's national cyber security frameworks and the Gulf (GCC) threat landscape
Ability to mentor and supervise students effectively
Computer Science Department | Part-time | Foundation and Bachelor Programs
Deliver Swinburne units in the Foundation program and the Bachelor of Computer Science.
Deliver course materials in alignment with partner university standards.
Mark assessments aligned with learning outcomes and partner university standards.
Supervise student projects, capstone work, and internships.
Utilize modern teaching methodologies including blended and online learning platforms.
Maintain accurate academic records and comply with institutional policies.
Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a closely related field from a recognised university, eligible for MoEHE equivalency and Swinburne teaching approval.
University-level teaching experience, or strong evidence of training, coaching, or mentoring.
Able to teach at least two units on campus in Doha, with highly fluent English.
Industry or start-up experience is highly desirable; TNE experience is an advantage.
Proven expertise, through industry, portfolio, certifications, or teaching, in at least one of:
Full-stack development: building, testing, and deploying web applications end to end.
Cloud computing: designing, deploying, and securing cloud solutions, with a current AWS certification.
Introductory computing: teaching Scratch or Python, and web publishing with WordPress.
AI and machine learning: building or deploying ML models and teaching introductory AI.
Hold regular office hours to support students with their learning and development.
Contribute to the wider academic and school life of the College, such as Open Days, conferences, and student engagement events.
Additional expectations regarding wider contribution to the School will be discussed at interview.
r: Deliver Swinburne units in Cybersecurity and related Computer Science subjects, at Bachelor and Master's level.
Develop and update course materials in alignment with partner university standards.
Design and evaluate assessments aligned with learning outcomes and partner university standards.
Supervise student projects, capstone work, and internships.
Utilize modern teaching methodologies including blended and online learning platforms.
Maintain accurate academic records and comply with institutional policies.
Conduct independent and collaborative research in cybersecurity domains.
Publish in reputable peer-reviewed journals and conferences.
Contribute to research strategy and innovation initiatives.
Engage in applied research relevant to industry and national priorities that leads to practical outcomes such as industry-funded projects, deployed tools, intellectual property or start-ups.
Participate in curriculum review and program enhancement.
Ensure compliance with accreditation and quality assurance requirements.
Contribute to academic committees and departmental initiatives.
Support internship placements and applied industry projects.
Mentor student ventures through the BUC Innovation Sandbox and contribute to technology commercialisation teaching.
Deliver workshops, seminars, or professional development training when required.
x: Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV to careers@buc.edu.qa, mentioning the position they are applying for in the subject line.

d: AHS is a Dubai-based group focused on ultra-luxury real estate development, strategic investments, and high-value ventures. The business is built around exceptional standards, thoughtful execution, and high-touch experiences for a discerning global clientele.

Within this environment, every client interaction reflects the brand. This role supports a premium front-of-house experience where service, presentation, and attention to detail are central to how clients experience the Sales Gallery.

As Waiter, you will play an important part in creating a refined and welcoming atmosphere for ultra-high-net-worth clients, working closely with hospitality and sales colleagues to deliver a seamless visit from arrival through departure.
q: At least a high school education.
5+ years of experience serving private events and delivering UHNW guest service.
Guest-facing service experience with discerning international clients.
Availability for client visits, private events, evenings, and weekends.
5+ years of experience in luxury hotels.
Knowledge of premium beverage service, presentation, and luxury-service etiquette.
r: Serve premium refreshments with polished presentation and impeccable luxury-service etiquette.
Welcome UHNW clients and provide attentive service throughout Sales Gallery visits.
Anticipate client preferences while maintaining discretion, professionalism, and strict confidentiality.
Keep guest-facing spaces, service stations, and presentation materials immaculately prepared.
Coordinate with sales and hospitality teams to ensure seamless client experiences.
